description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for entity functions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes several concrete subclasses for common string functions like LENGTH, TRIM, UPPER, and LOWER, and provides methods for creating and manipulating such functions, often in the context of building database queries or conditions.

classes.name: EntityFunction
classes.description: Abstract base class for defining entity functions such as LENGTH, TRIM, UPPER, LOWER.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Creates a LENGTH function wrapping the given value or nested condition.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Creates a TRIM function wrapping the given value or nested condition.

methods.name: upper
methods.description: Creates an UPPER case function wrapping the given value or nested condition.

methods.name: lower
methods.description: Creates a LOWER case function wrapping the given value or nested condition.
